X.description:
The coordinates of the values in Z.

Python: array-like

Y.description:
The coordinates of the values in Z.

Python: array-like

Z.description:
The height values over which the contour is drawn.

Python: array-like(N, M)

levels.description:
Determines the number and positions of the contour lines / regions.

Python: int or array-like

cornerMask.description:
Enable/disable corner masking, which only has an effect if Z is a masked array. If False, any quad touching a masked point is masked out. If True, only the triangular corners of quads nearest those points are always masked out, other triangular corners comprising three unmasked points are contoured as usual.
(matplotlib corner_mask)

colors.description:
The colors of the levels, i.e. the lines for contour and the areas for contourf.

Python: color string or sequence of colors

alpha.description: The alpha blending value, between 0 (transparent) and 1 (opaque).

cmap.description:
A Colormap instance or registered colormap name. The colormap maps the level values to colors. Defaults to rcParams["image.cmap"].

Python: str or Colormap

norm.description:
If a colormap is used, the Normalize instance scales the level values to the canonical colormap range [0, 1] for mapping to colors. If not given, the default linear scaling is used.

Python: Normalize

vMin.description:
If not None, either or both of these values will be supplied to the Normalize instance, overriding the default color scaling based on levels.
(matplotlib vmin)

vMax.description:
If not None, either or both of these values will be supplied to the Normalize instance, overriding the default color scaling based on levels.
(matplotlib vmax)

origin.description:
Determines the orientation and exact position of Z by specifying the position of Z[0, 0]. This is only relevant, if X, Y are not given.

Python: {None, 'upper', 'lower', 'image'}

extent.description:
If origin is not None, then extent is interpreted as in matplotlib.pyplot.imshow(): it gives the outer pixel boundaries. In this case, the position of Z[0,0] is the center of the pixel, not a corner. If origin is None, then (x0, y0) is the position of Z[0,0], and (x1, y1) is the position of Z[-1,-1].

Python: (x0, x1, y0, y1)

locator.description:
The locator is used to determine the contour levels if they are not given explicitly via levels. Defaults to MaxNLocator.

Python: Locator

xUnits.description:
Override axis units by specifying an instance of a matplotlib.units.ConversionInterface.
(matplotlib xunits)

Python: registered units, optional

yUnits.description:
Override axis units by specifying an instance of a matplotlib.units.ConversionInterface.
(matplotlib yunits)

Python: registered units, optional

antialiased.description:
Enable antialiasing, overriding the defaults. For filled contours, the default is True. For line contours, it is taken from rcParams["lines.antialiased"].

Python: bool, optinal

NChunk.description:
If 0, no subdivision of the domain. Specify a positive integer to divide the domain into subdomains of nchunk by nchunk quads. Chunking reduces the maximum length of polygons generated by the contouring algorithm which reduces the rendering workload passed on to the backend and also requires slightly less RAM. It can however introduce rendering artifacts at chunk boundaries depending on the backend, the antialiased flag and value of alpha.
(matplotlib Nchunk)

Python: int >= 0

lineWidths.description:
Only applies to contour.
(matplotlib linewidths)

Python: float or sequence of float

hatches.description:
Only applies to contourf.

Python: List[str]
